en.topic_title: Hong Kong court orders retrial of man charged with murdering taxi driver after jury fails to reach majority verdict
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong court has ordered a retrial of a man accused of murdering a taxi driver in 2021 after the jury failed to reach a majority verdict.



Hong Kong police arresting Matthew Choi, who was suspected in the stabbing of a taxi driver, on October 13, 2021. Photo: Hong Kong Police Force, via X.



Matthew Choi, 36, had pleaded not guilty to one count of murder. He was arrested on Lamma Island in October 2021 after a night-shift taxi driver was stabbed to death.
